Highly recommended in every way ;)
Sep 2026 • Family
We had our final dinner of a 3-day family trip to Da Nang at this hotel restaurant, and it was, without a doubt, an unforgettable experience.

Every single dish was outstanding in both taste and presentation. The ingredients were incredibly fresh, and the plating was truly beautiful. What impressed us most was how much my father enjoyed his meal—he is usually quite indifferent about food, but he said, "This is really delicious!" at least three times while eating his steak 😂 

Beyond the exceptional food, the service was truly exemplary. A special thanks to our waitress, Vy, who took such wonderful care of us throughout the evening. She was exceptionally warm, attentive, and thoughtful—even noticing we were running low on sauces and refilling them before we even had to ask. Her flawless English communication also made our dining experience entirely seamless and relaxed.

It was the most satisfying and heartwarming way to conclude our time in Da Nang. We are deeply grateful for such a memorable evening!

Vy, Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều!

Exquisite hidden gem in the heart of the city!
Sep 2026 • Solo
What a wonderful find! Môc Garden Restaurant completely exceeded my expectations. VY took care of me so nicely amd sweet and the service was exquisite — she was so kind, attentive, and helpful throughout the whole meal.
What really surprised me was learning that all the food comes fresh from their own garden. You can genuinely taste the difference — everything felt vibrant and just-picked.
The setting is unbeatable too: a lush garden oasis right in the center of the city, which made for such a peaceful and beautiful dining experience.
I had the fresh spring rolls, a seafood tart, and cheesecake for dessert — every single dish was amazingly delicious. I'd recommend Moc Garden to anyone visiting the area. I can't wait to go back!
